guide.text: Increases Beast Boy's Spiritual Defense. At the start of battle, his Spiritual Defense is further increased for a short time, and he immediately transforms into a T-Rex and lets out a roar, reducing all enemies' Attack and spiritual damage dealt. [Teen Titans] and [Outsiders] allies also gain extra Energy.
